description: List every page of the OnlyMCP documentation with its short name, title and one-line summary. Meant for an overview of what is documented or for picking a page; not for answering a question about the product by itself. Answers one line per page, in the order of the website. Reads only public documentation.

language.description: Language of the answer: en (default), de, fr or it. A page not yet translated comes back in English.

name: list_docs
title: List the documentation pages
